title: Light Presets
description: One-click lighting presets in the scene lighting toolbar, working like the core wall type buttons: click a preset, then drag to place. Fourteen presets across four groups — flame (Candle, Torch, Lantern, Bullseye Lantern, Campfire, Chimney, Lava Glow), atmosphere (Moonlight, Fog Bank, Fey Lights, Ghostly), radiant magic (Magical Glow, Divine Radiance), and a Magical Darkness source. Each preset fully specifies its light configuration, so switching never inherits leftover values, and bright/dim behaviour is applied live in the drag preview. Built on the V14 placeable palette system: system-agnostic, no dependencies, no external assets.
